en: A metal screw is actually an inclined plane wrapped around a cylinder, which multiplies your turning force.
A gecko can climb smooth glass because millions of microscopic hairs on its feet create strong molecular attraction.
Because Earth bulges at the equator, you weigh slightly less there than you would at the North Pole.
If you break a permanent magnet in half, each new piece instantly forms its own north and south poles.
A single bolt of lightning contains enough electrical energy to toast approximately one hundred thousand slices of bread.
A flat mirror reverses images left-to-right, which is why the word AMBULANCE is painted backward on vehicle hoods.
The 1883 eruption of Krakatoa produced the loudest sound in recorded history, rupturing eardrums 64 kilometers away.
A thermos flask keeps liquids hot by using a sealed vacuum layer between its walls to block conductive heat transfer.
A stretched bow stores elastic potential energy, which instantly transforms into kinetic energy when the string releases the arrow.
Because of inertia, your body continues moving forward at the car's original speed during a sudden, hard brake.
A traditional roller coaster uses only gravity and inertia for the entire ride, needing no engine after the first hill.
Light travels about a million times faster than sound, which is why you see lightning before hearing the thunder.
